components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive Send and New chat actions in Route Mint.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; color: #0A1012; background: #61D095; border: 1px solid #61D095; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7ADDA8; border-color: #7ADDA8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2E9D8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #61D095; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting commands held inside the charcoal control hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #172226; border: 1px solid #3C5358; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2A393E; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #61D095; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #111A1E; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Stop action reserved for interruption and failure semantics.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; color: #E6544D; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #E6544D; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { color: #F2E9D8; background: #562727; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #61D095; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #562727; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed search or text input with a border-only focus signal.
components.css: .ds-input-field { min-height: 34px; padding: 9px 11px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #0D1518; border: 1px solid #2A393E; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #A8B7B3; } .ds-input-field:hover { border-color: #3C5358; } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #61D095; }

components.name: Runtime Rail
components.description: The top status instrument shared by Quick Copilot and Full Chat.
components.css: .ds-runtime-rail { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #111A1E; border: 1px solid #2A393E; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-runtime-rail:hover { border-color: #3C5358; } .ds-runtime-lamp { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #61D095; } .ds-runtime-state { color: #61D095; font: 700 11px "Hack Nerd Font Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-runtime-detail { color: #A8B7B3; }

components.name: Composer Shell
components.description: The grounded control bed that keeps composition attached to the route.
components.css: .ds-composer-shell { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #172226; border: 1px solid #3C5358; border-radius: 15px; font: 400 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-composer-shell:focus-within { border-color: #61D095; } .ds-composer-input { flex: 1; min-height: 70px; resize: none; color: #F2E9D8; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 7px 8px; font: inherit; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: #A8B7B3; } .ds-composer-input:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-composer-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-composer-actions button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #172226; border: 1px solid #3C5358; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-composer-actions button:hover { background: #2A393E; } .ds-composer-actions button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #61D095; }

narrative.overview:
Signal Cabin treats Zara as an operational conversation instrument: charcoal enamel grounds the workspace, warm ivory carries the exchange, and small illuminated signals report runtime truth. The atmosphere is calm, exact, and native to a Linux desktop rather than theatrical or ornamental.

One conversation follows one visible route from Quick Copilot into Full Chat. Status anchors the top, the transcript owns the field, and the composer forms a grounded control bed; the system explicitly rejects generic AI-card chrome, decorative gradients, and fabricated access cues.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous route-divider transcript instead of message cards.
Compact status rails with restrained, fixed signal semantics.
The same material and state language at Quick and Full working scales.
Native Qt density, keyboard focus, and honest runtime copy.

rules.name: The Signal Semantics Rule
rules.body: Mint means ready or complete, amber means work in progress, and red means stop or failure; these meanings never drift between surfaces.

rules.name: The Three-Gauge Rule
rules.body: Narrow type names the instrument, Adwaita carries human language, and mono reports machine state; do not swap those roles for novelty.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface earns depth through charcoal tone and a precise border, never through blur, glow, glass, or drop shadow.

dos: Do keep Quick Copilot and Full Chat visibly made from the same materials, tokens, and route grammar.
Do reserve saturated color for runtime meaning, selection, focus, and decisive actions.
Do keep the conversation field open and continuous, with role and state attached to the route.
Do preserve native Qt controls, keyboard behavior, readable contrast, and explicit runtime wording.
donts: Don't turn messages, tools, or status into a stack of generic rounded AI cards.
Don't add gradients, glass, ambient glow, drop shadows, or decorative raster texture.
Don't use mint, amber, or red outside their fixed operational meanings.
Don't imply screen, clipboard, file, or application access through decoration or unsupported copy.
